expo.name: The Poker Club
expo.//: Two themes, dark and light — the OS decides which. Never pin this to one.
expo.//scheme: Watchers open a share link that deep-links straight into the session.
expo.//updates: Over-the-air updates. A wrong number found on poker night can be fixed in minutes instead of waiting on App Store review — one of the main reasons for choosing Expo.
expo.//runtimeVersion: appVersion ties an update to the app version it was built for, so JavaScript that expects newer native code can never land on an older build.
